This enables GSE to predict likely next actions based on historical patterns. The injury status vector introduces uncertainty into player availability, which is modeled as a binary classification system within GSI’s Bayesian framework. The coach stability index captures organizational consistency, influencing both GSI’s belief propagation and GSE’s adaptive strategy. These primitives form a dual structure where deterministic play patterns interact with probabilistic player and leadership variables, creating a dynamic system susceptible to regime shifts during injury events or coaching changes.
